title: xDrip+ can work on a Xiaomi with MIUI 10.3.10 (Android 9)?
symptom: User is concerned that xDrip+ may not work on a Xiaomi Redmi Note 7 with MIUI 10.3.10 (Android 9) due to reported problems with Android 9 on many smartphones.
evidence_quote: My doubt is that, having seen that many smartphones had big problems with Android 9, this one could not be working with xDrip+.
